overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Luxury metaverse shopping experience for IFSG. 2D/3D concept, spatial and interaction design, UX, and creative team direction.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Translate luxury retail presence into metaverse without losing tactility or curation.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: Directed spatial concept across 2D/3D — interaction design, environmental storytelling and team leadership for a shoppable virtual flagship.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: IFSG luxury metaverse retail — immersive commerce that preserves brand world while enabling spatial exploration.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for IFSG — Luxury metaverse shopping experience for IFSG. 2D/3D concept, spatial and interaction design, UX, and creative team direction.
